neighbours.label: a mathematical collection being defined: 'the set of all ...', 'the space of ...', 'the lattice of ...' introducing the members of a set, space or structure; everyday 'set of', 'all the' and physical 'space of' stay low
fire: Let S be the set of all even integers greater than ten.
We study the space of bounded linear operators on a Hilbert space.
The lattice of subgroups of a finite group has a top element.
Define V as the set of all vectors orthogonal to the given plane.
The space of smooth functions on the circle is infinite-dimensional.
Consider the set of all real numbers whose square is less than two.
The ring of polynomials over a field is a principal ideal domain.
The collection of all open subsets forms a topology on X.
quiet: Let me know if you find the set of spare keys in the drawer.
We cleared the space under the stairs for the new bicycles.
The tray of cookies on the counter has a burnt corner.
Define your goals before you start the new training plan.
The space in the garage is full of old furniture.
Consider all the guests who will arrive late on Friday.
The ring on her finger was a gift from her grandmother.
The collection of stamps filled three thick albums.
